component_instructions.file_structure: Use standard React files with JavaScript (.js extension, not .tsx). Ensure lucide-react, recharts / chart components, sonner toast, and tailwind classes are used.
component_instructions.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, table rows, and metric cards MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="login-submit-button", data-testid="upload-dropzone", data-testid="kpi-rasio-elektrifikasi", data-testid="kecamatan-table-row-01", data-testid="btn-export-excel").
component_instructions.responsive: Ensure seamless sidebar toggling for tablet and mobile viewports with smooth drawer backdrop.
component_instructions.interactivity: All filter dropdowns, search inputs, modal popups, step transitions, and tab switches MUST be fully interactive with realistic state management and dynamic UI update feedback.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing for clean data scannability. Containers with border must have padding on text content to avoid collision.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute for stable testing.
Prioritize pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, override fixed height restrictions if content gets cut off.
